tooltip.blockopener.block_opener.lore: Open ANY block. Some will drop custom items!
tooltip.blockopener.block_opener.power.2: Sneak + right-click: use the block normally
tooltip.blockopener.block_opener.power.3: Ores hide structure loot, special blocks hide secret items
Sneak 3 seconds: pumpkin transformation (mobs lose you)
tooltip.blockopener.bee_drill.power.2: Right-click a mob (even far away): bees attack!
tooltip.blockopener.bee_drill.power.3: Your bees defend you and never lose their stinger
tooltip.blockopener.anvil_chestplate.pow: Jump + sneak: explosive slam that OPENS every block around
tooltip.blockopener.diamond_leggings.pow: Empty hand swing shoots fireballs during flight
Speed II, no fall damage while flight is on
tooltip.blockopener.dripstone_sword.lore: Pointy end goes into the enemy.
tooltip.blockopener.dripstone_sword.powe: Right-click: Dripstone Rain where you look
Hold: pulls nearby items to you
tooltip.blockopener.bedrock_bucket.power: Right-click: pour Void Water (never runs empty)
Void Water eats items and hurts through armor
tooltip.blockopener.mossphere.power.1: Throw: kills anything it hits. Anything.
Right-click: become a GIANT (reach, damage, steps over walls)
Sneak + right-click: become tiny (fits through 1x1 holes, mobs lose you)
Use the same way again to go back to normal
tooltip.blockopener.weeping_totem.lore: It cries so you don't have to.
Works from anywhere in your inventory
Cheats death once, even falling into the void
Puts you back on the last solid ground you stood on
tooltip.blockopener.mob_cage.power.2: Right-click a block: release it as your ally
tooltip.blockopener.mob_cage.power.3: Allies attack whatever you hit and never attack you
tooltip.blockopener.storm_hammer.power.2: Jump attack: a ring of lightning around the target
tooltip.blockopener.storm_hammer.power.3: Your own storm never hurts you
tooltip.blockopener.glass_spyglass.power: Look through it: ores glow through walls
Also shows the blocks hiding the items you are missing
tooltip.blockopener.obsidian_shield.powe: Blocks attacks from every side, never breaks
Sneak + right-click: obsidian dome for 10 seconds
tooltip.blockopener.ender_gloves.lore: Personal space is just a suggestion.
tooltip.blockopener.ender_gloves.power.1: Right-click: teleport where you look (64 blocks)
tooltip.blockopener.ender_gloves.power.2: Right-click a mob: swap places with it
tooltip.blockopener.ender_gloves.power.3: Endermen ignore you while you hold them
tooltip.blockopener.slime_gloves.power.3: Hold: no fall damage, you bounce (sneak to land softly)
tooltip.blockopener.ice_wand.power.1: Right-click: freeze a mob in a block of ice
tooltip.blockopener.ice_wand.power.2: Hold: water freezes under your feet
tooltip.blockopener.magma_fist.power.1: Every hit sets the target on fire
tooltip.blockopener.magma_fist.power.3: Hold: fireproof, lava cools into a crust under you
tooltip.blockopener.cake_of_life.lore: The cake is real. And infinite.
tooltip.blockopener.cake_of_life.power.1: Eat: heals and fills your hunger
tooltip.blockopener.cake_of_life.power.2: Never gets used up (8 second cooldown)
Right-click: honey shot glues mobs in place
Sneak + right-click: spread of five shots
Leaves sticky honey blocks where it lands

blockopener.hud.title: Custom items %s/%s

blockopener.size_mushroom.no_room: Not enough room to grow here!

blockopener.command.help.timer: start <min> [sec] | pause | stop | add <sec> - challenge countdown
blockopener.command.help.locate: <item> highlight the nearest block hiding that item
blockopener.command.help.testrow: place all secret blocks in front of you (2 rows in extended mode)
blockopener.command.help.showcase: [seconds] | clear - float all the items in front of you
blockopener.command.help.settings: world settings (explosions, loot rolls, extended items...)
blockopener.command.help.open: <pos> open a block from a command
blockopener.command.complete: All items marked as found for %s player(s)
blockopener.command.locate.none: No %s within %s blocks (only loaded chunks are searched)
blockopener.command.timer.zero: The timer needs at least 1 second
blockopener.command.settings.explosionsD: ability explosions blow up dropped items (like TNT)
blockopener.command.settings.announceFin: announce custom item finds in chat
blockopener.command.settings.lootRolls: how many times a block's loot is rolled
